mapper.select: select d.id,d.title,u.real_name as sender,d.content,g.subject_name,d.create_time from t_discussion as d join t_user as u on d.user_id = u.id join t_subject as g on d.subject_id = g.id where d.id = #{id}

select d.id,d.title,u.real_name as sender,g.subject_name as subjectName,d.create_time from t_discussion as d join t_user as u on d.user_id = u.id join t_subject as g on d.subject_id = g.id
and d.title like concat('%',#{title},'%')
and d.subject_id = #{subjectId}
order by d.create_time desc

select d.id,d.title,u.real_name as sender,g.subject_name as subjectName,d.create_time from t_discussion as d join t_user as u on d.user_id = u.id join t_subject as g on d.subject_id = g.id
and d.title like concat('%',#{title},'%')

select d.id,d.title,u.real_name as sender,g.subject_name as subjectName,d.create_time from t_discussion as d join t_user as u on d.user_id = u.id join t_subject as g on d.subject_id = g.id join t_user_subject as us on d.subject_id = us.subject_id
us.user_id = #{userId} and us.is_deleted = 0
and d.title like concat('%',#{title},'%')
order by d.create_time desc
